bookingOpens: Online through TableCheck (the restaurant's official booking page) until two days before, or by phone; bookings for the next day or the same day by phone only. Bookings made through the AutoReserve AI booking service are not accepted.
cancellation: A booking may be cancelled if guests are more than 30 minutes late without getting in touch.
groups: Parties of five or more should contact the restaurant directly.
dressCode: No dress code is published; guests are asked not to wear perfume or other strong scents.
children: Children must be of secondary-school age (about 12) or older; there is no children's menu, so they have the adult course.
